meta.title: Send test push (dev)
meta.description: Query the newest active subscription and send a thank-you test notification. Adapt connection name and route to your project.

flow.name: query
flow.comment: Latest active row only — set limit: 1 and order by id desc in the query builder JSON

options.sql: SELECT * FROM push_subscriptions WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

options.title: Mr Cheese
options.body: I hope you are enjoying this extension.  Please Buy Me a Coffee if you can afford it.  Doing this really helps me to create further extensions like this one

notes: Call via GET or POST after a browser subscription exists — e.g. curl http://localhost:3000/api/pushNotifications/test
Set nocsrf: true on the API if testing without CSRF token.
Replace title/body in production with real alert text bound from your data.
